decisions.reason: Persistent visible in-field text may be incompatible with a simple-text mechanism that users can delete, but the source does not specify whether that architecture is superseded or what replacement mechanism should be used.
The existing message-197 MODIFY already fully records the required visible in-field guidance and permission to duplicate help text in the label and field.
Requiring visible instructional text does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.

The instruction not to leave a field without visible in-field text may conflict with automatic placeholder removal on click, but it is unclear whether click-to-clear is superseded or whether help text should instead reappear only after user content is emptied.
The visible-help-text decision does not alter the calendar-dropdown date-entry method.
The decision concerns visible instructional text in editable fields and does not change the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
The source changes help-text visibility and duplication, not the Danish language or the specified date and subject placeholder wording.
Visible instructional text in editable fields is unrelated to containment of pasted tables and columns.
The source does not change bullet sizing, appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The field-specific help-text decision leaves the supported Word environment and general reliability constraints unchanged.
The source concerns editable-field visibility and does not alter Enter-key bullet creation.
The visible in-field help-text decision does not affect legacy-content paste behavior, test files, or the unresolved formatting workflow.
